thread:
Sam (Sales): Heads up — Acme wants a hosted POC with a hard per-token cap and wants the min monthly charge waived for the trial. They want to try 10M tokens over 30 days.
Priya (Account Exec): Details: they'd prefer $0.0007/token cap for generation, embeddings separate. No upfront commit; evaluating for enterprise purchase. They asked about tiering to avoid hitting the min charge.
Maya (RevOps): FYI standard POC policy is no per-token overrides without commit. Min charge usually $1k/mo for hosted pilot. Need deal desk approval. @DealDesk Bot can we get a fast pathway?
DealDesk Bot: Request logged: DD-2026-128. Required: justification, expected ARR, legal signoff. ETA 48h. If revenue > $100k ARR, can escalate.
Alex (Eng): Perf note — if we cap at $0.0007/token we'll likely route them to a quantized variant. Need to flag potential quality differences. Also need capacity check for 10M tokens in 30d — that's ~3.8 TPS sustained on typical model.
Sam (Sales): They explicitly said "no model quality regressions" — will share evaluation prompts. Can we propose a time-limited override for the POC only? 30 days.
Maya (RevOps): Proposed compromise: waive min charge for first 30 days + offer $3k credit. In return ask for a 60d SOC/feedback window and a preferred pricing term on conversion (12mo commit at $100k ARR).
Priya (Account Exec): I can push for 12mo commit at 100k ARR if they convert. Acme is SSO + encrypted logs, legal will want data handling terms.
Jordan (Legal): We'll need an LOA for the POC referencing data boundaries. No special IP concessions. I'll draft a short addendum.
Maya (RevOps): If Deal Desk grants temporary per-token override, we should add a guardrail: max total tokens 12M + auto-revert to standard tier. Also require failure modes: fallback to lower-cost model if latency spikes.
DealDesk Bot: Status update: DD-2026-128 -> Provisionally approved: 30d per-token cap $0.0009/gen, embeddings unchanged, min charge waived, $3k credit. Conditions: LOA signed, analytics ping every 72h, auto-revert. Final signoff pending Legal.
Sam (Sales): Great — I'll get the LOA and the eval prompts today. Thanks everyone :raised_hands: 
Alex (Eng): Put the eval prompts in the thread when ready and tag me — will run quick perf QA.
Priya (Account Exec): I'll coordinate next steps with Acme and prep convert offer steps.
Jordan (Legal): Drafting LOA now, should be in 3-4 hours.
Sam (Sales): tagging completion: @Maya (RevOps) @Alex (Eng) — will update after LOA and evals.
